company.description: Plastus offers products that are created using the fermentation process of bacteria with an environmentally friendly carbon source. They convert organic waste into bioplastics, which are produced through the fermentation process of bacteria. Their integration into PHA’s should lead to a decrease in fossil fuel use and significantly reduce carbon emissions.
